verdict: Roti telur is better for losing weight. Calories are about the same, but it has double the protein and less fat.
why: Calories are almost the same: roti telur is about 400 kcal, roti planta about 420 kcal.
Roti telur has about 14 g protein, roti planta only about 7 g. Egg keeps you full longer.
Roti planta has about 25 g fat vs 20 g for roti telur, because of the extra margarine.
Roti planta tastes good and feels light, so it's easy to add a second piece without noticing.
when_a: Roti telur is good when you want one really filling piece for breakfast.
when_b: Roti planta is okay as an occasional treat, like a weekend lepak with friends.
tip: Ask for roti telur 'kurang minyak' (less oil) and eat it with dhal. Skip the second piece, and go for plain water or teh o 'kurang manis' (less sweet).

faq.q: Is roti telur with onion still okay?
faq.a: Okay. Onion adds only a few calories, but makes it tastier so one piece feels more satisfying.

faq.q: How often can I eat roti planta?
faq.a: There's no ban. If you want to lose weight, make it occasional and keep your other meals that day lighter.
